arguments.prompt: Create a transparent reference strip containing exactly FOUR separate isolated heads of Krusher Dom, matching the four supplied native pixel-art heads in identity, art style and low pixel density. Brown side-parted swept hair, short brown beard, fair skin. No goggles, no hat, no helmet. Maintain ONE consistent physical skull size and hair/beard appearance. The heads should be upright and neutral. Left to right: 1 front-right three-quarter view, halfway between front-facing and profile looking screen RIGHT; 2 front-left three-quarter view looking screen LEFT; 3 rear-right three-quarter view, halfway between rear and profile, mostly the BACK of the head with right-facing ear and only a sliver of cheek, no visible paired eyes; 4 rear-left three-quarter view, mostly back of head with left-facing ear and only a sliver of cheek. Each head fully isolated with generous transparent margins, no neck beyond a few pixels, no shoulders, no body, no text or labels. Strict game sprite pixel-art with crisp coherent chunky pixel clusters; reference art has skull width about23 native pixels and height28 native pixels, so do not introduce fine subpixel strand or photorealistic texture. Return one wide horizontal strip; all four heads on same level, not touching. Preserve the reference asymmetrical parting through genuine different views.

scope: Four upright independent intermediate yaw heads. One23px maximum width ruler; no per-head size normalization. Fitted cargo sources in cargo-family-v1.
